Standard: For boom tanker systems only, boom system automatically commands a disconnect such that a disconnect occurs prior to exceeding boom disconnect limits. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of specifications and system description documents verifies design incorporates boom system auto disconnect function that disconnects prior to exceeding the boom disconnect limits. Analysis.
  (1) Analysis shows boom system design will automatically command and achieve a disconnect prior to exceeding the boom disconnect limits. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Hardware-in-the-loop laboratory testing verifies the boom system automatically commands and achieves a disconnect prior to exceeding the boom disconnect limits. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (2) Flight test: AR flight test verifies boom system automatically commands and achieves a disconnect before receiver-specific boom disconnect limits are reached.
